svg.aria-label: The lit-review mode, detailed view. Boxes: academic-paper 3.2.0: Intake, citation verification: mark only or strict (stop); Literature strategist (agent); You review the sources: add or remove, optional (stop); Annotated bibliography, literature matrix, synthesis (agent) | paper, as ruled: Intake: config.md, DOI checking, the research question the run needs [D24, O, AD11, AV15]; a research report and its bibliography [AV1]; the profile [AV2]; a file in words [AQ] (stop); Session: the search themes, one per research community, each with its strands and range, in config.md Decisions [The theme search] (question); Literature strategist, theme run: search theme 1, its own theme-1/ folder, review-theme-1.md and refs-theme-1.bib [The theme search]; gap chaining once after the passes [Examples ruling] (ruled, only when needed); Literature strategist, theme runs: each other search theme, all at once, each in its own folder [The theme search]; gap chaining once after the passes [Examples ruling] (ruled, only when needed); Literature strategist, merge run, fresh: one entry per work, the criteria again, the cut sources, chaining from the theme runs' core papers, then gap chaining [Examples ruling], each pair of themes, the gates; review.md, refs.bib [The theme search] (ruled, only when needed); Literature strategist: review.md, refs.bib, a .bib patch when a .tex is given; a list over 50 entries shows its first 20 and last 5; it does not start without a research question [D48, D2, AD11, AV15, AV16]; then gap chaining [Examples ruling] (ruled, only when needed); The gates: a search for each part of the question; a short count widened by 5 years, then by unused indexes; up to 3 currency passes; a synthesis by part [The simulation in step 5.F] (ruled); An unread candidate looked up again before it is dropped; each entry confirmed against an index with resolve --entry: corrected once, else left out of refs.bib and named [BI]; a later version under another title cited as published [BW] (ruled); You review the sources: add or remove, optional [J]; after theme runs, each search theme with its count [The theme search] (stop); Script, run by the session: resolve --entry on every entry of refs.bib before the patch; the count it confirmed in the final message [Examples ruling] (script); Script: apply the .bib patch [D48] (script); Script: reference checks [D48] (script); Draft writer: reference-fix, once [K] (ruled); Script: reference checks again, failures left named [K] (script); A reference that cannot be confirmed [O] (stop); End (agent); At every patch: a structural patch, a patch that does not apply (retry as often as you ask, write it again in full, or leave it [BR]), a script failed [C] (stop); At every agent start: a model other than the configured one [D47] (stop).
